powers.text: It bonds two objects together for good. (No other effect in the game.)

summary: An adhesive that bonds any two objects together permanently.
text: A thick, milky-white adhesive that permanently bonds any two objects. It can only be kept in a jar or flask whose inside has been coated with Oil of Slipperiness; a container found holds 1d6 + 1 ounces. Each ounce covers a 1-foot square. It sets in 1 minute, after which the bond can be broken only by Universal Solvent, Oil of Etherealness, or a Wish spell.
